items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with two assertions: if X is reduced then the scheme theoretic image Z of f : X -> Y is the reduced induced structure on the closure of |f|(|X|), and its formation commutes with etale base change (source lines 3286-3296). The proof of (1) uses that the reduced induced structure is the smallest closed subspace through which f factors, which is a universal property statement for maps into a reduction; part (2) follows from (1) together with openness of |V| -> |Y| and the preservation of reducedness under etale localization.
